\# Repository Instructions



When adding a new Project Euler solution:



1\. Follow README.md.

2\. Use folder format:



&#x20;  0001-problem-title



3\. Create exactly:



&#x20;  - solution.cpp

&#x20;  - explanation.md



4\. Keep explanations concise.



5\. Add optional sections only when genuinely useful.



6\. Do not include full Project Euler problem statements.



7\. Use commit message:



&#x20;  Solve Project Euler #XXXX - Problem Title



8\. One problem per commit.
